claims.claim: Base Camp Edogawabashi is a useful candidate for a Tokyo climbing day when you want a choice between bouldering and ropes. The [operator’s introduction](https://b-camp.jp/edogawabashi/) lists bouldering, lead climbing and top-rope climbing. Those options require different preparation. This guide uses published information; admission should not be treated as evidence that a visitor has been trained to belay.

claims.claim: If you want to try ropes without an established partner and the necessary skills, consult the [first-visit information](https://b-camp.jp/edogawabashi/visitor/). Its top-rope experience is one hour for ¥1,100, with a separate facility fee. Participants need to have completed the bouldering introduction or have bouldering experience; check the available session through the operator’s booking arrangements. General admission, a bouldering introduction and the top-rope experience are different services. Budget and book them separately.

Registration is shared across Base Camp branches, so ask reception to check an existing membership rather than assuming you need to pay registration again.
